summary: Serves as the root package for the gyomu_ai application, coordinating core domain logic including error handling, execution management, model identification, provider integrations, and AI tool execution.
responsibilities: Define application-specific error types and exception handling.
Manage execution context, parameters, policies, and results for AI operations.
Represent core AI model identification and structures.
Integrate external AI provider backends and map standard components.
Define AI tool execution logic, configuration, and result handling.
relationships: The execution, model, provider, and tool directories work together to manage AI operations, model interactions, and tool executions.
design_decisions: Organizes core application components into modular packages covering error handling, execution management, model representation, provider integration, and tool execution.
